nodes.name: server_access_control.go
nodes.summary: Defines HTTP access-control checks for CORS origins and host allowlists used by the embedded etcd server.
nodes.languageNotes: Go implementation using protobuf RPC types, raft interfaces, concurrency primitives, and Prometheus or zap integration where applicable.

nodes.name: server_access_control_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests CORS origin matching and host allowlist behavior, including empty and configured policy cases.
nodes.languageNotes: Go implementation using protobuf RPC types, raft interfaces, concurrency primitives, and Prometheus or zap integration where applicable.

nodes.name: server_test.go
nodes.summary: Comprehensive etcd server integration tests covering apply/restart behavior, snapshots, membership changes, publishing, raft mocks, readiness, and feature-gate metrics.
nodes.languageNotes: Go implementation using protobuf RPC types, raft interfaces, concurrency primitives, and Prometheus or zap integration where applicable.

nodes.name: snapshot_merge.go
nodes.summary: Combines snapshot metadata and database content into a merged snapshot stream while coordinating temporary readers and cleanup.
nodes.languageNotes: Go implementation using protobuf RPC types, raft interfaces, concurrency primitives, and Prometheus or zap integration where applicable.
